# Git Manager Configuration Example

# Branch Naming Format
# Use {JIRA} as placeholder for Jira ticket ID
FEATURE_BRANCH_FORMAT=feature/{JIRA}
BUGFIX_BRANCH_FORMAT=bugfix/{JIRA}

# Alternative examples:
# FEATURE_BRANCH_FORMAT=feat/{JIRA}
# FEATURE_BRANCH_FORMAT={JIRA}-feature
# BUGFIX_BRANCH_FORMAT=fix/{JIRA}
# BUGFIX_BRANCH_FORMAT={JIRA}-bugfix

# Jira Ticket Pattern (regex)
# Pattern to extract Jira ID from branch names
# Leave empty to be prompted on first use (defaults to AI-[0-9]+ if not provided)
JIRA_PATTERN=HTM-[0-9]+

# Alternative examples for different Jira projects:
# JIRA_PATTERN=PROJ-[0-9]+
# JIRA_PATTERN=(TEAM1|TEAM2)-[0-9]+
# JIRA_PATTERN=[A-Z]+-[0-9]+
# JIRA_PATTERN=AI-[0-9]+
